entries.title: Psalms 82:1
segments: <<A Psalm of Asaph.>> God standeth in the congregation of God; He judgeth among the gods.

entries.title: Psalms 82:2
segments: How long will ye judge unjustly, And respect the persons of the wicked? Selah

entries.title: Psalms 82:3
segments: Judge the  poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.

entries.title: Psalms 82:4
segments: Rescue the poor and needy: Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 82:5
segments: They know not, neither do they understand; They walk to and fro in darkness: All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

entries.title: Psalms 82:6
segments: I said, Ye are gods, And all of you sons of the Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 82:7
segments: Nevertheless ye shall die like men, And fall like one of the princes.

entries.title: Psalms 82:8
segments: Arise, O God, judge the earth; For thou shalt inherit all the nations.
